summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operator surrogates require large labeled simulation datasets, while unlabeled input parameter fields are abundant but unexploited.
summary_en.method: PI-JEPA pretrains surrogates without any PDE solves via masked latent prediction on unlabeled fields, regularized by per-sub-operator PDE residuals aligned with Lie-Trotter splitting.
summary_en.result: On single-phase Darcy flow, PI-JEPA achieves 1.9x lower error than FNO and 2.4x lower than DeepONet with only 100 labeled samples.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark on single-phase Darcy flow demonstrates accuracy improvement over supervised-only training.

title: Variational Graph Neural Networks for Uncertainty Quantification in Inverse Problems

title: Incorporating Continuous Dependence Qualifies Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Operator Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进PINN的方法，通过引入PDE解的连续依赖性来提高算子学习性能，可迁移到生物力学代理模型中。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant mechanics problems, nor does it address constraints or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: PINN在真实应用中泛化性能差，限制了其使用。
summary_zh.method: 引入PDE解对参数和初边值的连续依赖性作为额外信息，改进PINN。
summary_zh.result: 在有限标注数据下，测试MSE比DeepONet和FNO低1-3个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个数值基准PDE问题上进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: The poor generalization of PINNs hinders their practical application in solving PDEs.
summary_en.method: A novel extension of PINNs (cd-PINN) incorporates the continuous dependence of PDE solutions on parameters and initial/boundary values as additional information.
summary_en.result: With limited labeled data, cd-PINN achieves 1-3 orders of magnitude lower test MSE than DeepONet and FNO.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical experiments on benchmark PDE problems demonstrate the effectiveness.

title: MAGPI: Multifidelity-Augmented Gaussian Process Inputs for Surrogate Modeling from Scarce Data
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多保真高斯过程方法可显著降低昂贵仿真的采样需求，适用于生物力学植入物设计中的代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it handle constraints or uncertainty quantification beyond standard GPR.

summary_zh.motivation: 昂贵高保真模型数据稀缺，代理模型不可靠。
summary_zh.method: 利用低保真数据定义额外特征，增强高斯过程输入空间。
summary_zh.result: 在多个测试问题上提高了预测精度并降低了计算成本。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试与现有方法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Expensive high-fidelity models limit training data, making surrogate models unreliable; low-fidelity models can provide additional data.
summary_en.method: A multifidelity Gaussian process regression approach that augments the input space with features derived from low-fidelity data.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves higher predictive accuracy and lower computational cost compared to state-of-the-art multifidelity GPR methods.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on several benchmark problems demonstrate the improvements.

summary_en.method: A computer vision-based closed-loop layer control system was developed to detect and correct printing defects in real time.
summary_en.result: High-fidelity multi-material soft tissue constructs were successfully printed with improved structural accuracy and material adaptability.
summary_en.validation: The platform was validated through case studies of various soft tissue constructs.

why_not_core: The paper does not embed AI into a specific bioprinting workflow stage (pre/in/post) beyond real-time adaptation, and lacks autonomous decision-making or experimental validation of AI models.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现复杂人体曲面上的快速原位生物打印，适用于手术室和资源有限环境。
summary_zh.method: 开发了基于屈服应力双相生物墨水的多喷嘴打印头，结合软体机器人实时适应曲面曲率。
summary_zh.result: 实现了450 mm²/s的高速沉积，细胞活力>85%，并在微重力下首次演示。

summary_en.motivation: To enable rapid in situ bioprinting on complex anatomical surfaces for point-of-care use in diverse environments including microgravity.
summary_en.method: A biphasic jammed gelatin microgel bioink with yield-stress behavior was delivered via multinozzle printheads, including a pneumatically actuated soft-robotic printhead with real-time curvature adaptation.
summary_en.result: The system achieved area coverage rates of 450 mm²/s, maintained cell viability above 85%, and demonstrated the first biphasic bioink deposition in microgravity.
summary_en.validation: Validation included curvature adaptation tests on convex surfaces and microgravity experiments aboard a parabolic flight.

title: Direct Interval Propagation Methods using Neural-Network Surrogates for Uncertainty Quantification in Physical Systems Surrogate Model
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对代理模型的不确定性量化问题，提出了高效的区间传播方法，可迁移至植入物力学设计中的不确定性分析。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it include any biomedical context or experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统区间传播方法计算成本高，需要大量优化求解。
summary_zh.method: 将区间传播重构为区间值回归问题，使用MLP和DeepONet直接预测输出边界。
summary_zh.result: 所提方法在保持精度的同时显著提升计算效率。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证了方法的准确性和效率。

summary_en.motivation: Standard interval propagation methods are computationally expensive due to nested optimization, limiting their use in complex systems.
summary_en.method: The paper reformulates interval propagation as an interval-valued regression problem and employs neural network surrogates (MLP, DeepONet) with bound propagation techniques (IBP, CROWN) and interval neural networks to directly predict output bounds.
summary_en.result: The proposed methods achieve significant computational speedup over traditional optimization-based approaches while maintaining accurate interval estimates.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks, demonstrating accuracy and efficiency of the interval propagation surrogates.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的持续学习方法可解决代理模型在分布偏移下的适应问题，对生物力学植入物设计中的多任务学习具有参考价值。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on continual learning for fluid dynamics surrogate models, not on implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or FEA-based design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决科学机器学习中代理模型在分布偏移下的灾难性遗忘问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于单层扩展的傅里叶神经算子（SLE-FNO）实现任务无关的持续学习。
summary_zh.result: SLE-FNO在动脉瘤血流TAWSS预测任务中实现零遗忘与高精度，平衡可塑性与稳定性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过230个CFD模拟构建四个顺序分布外任务进行对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address catastrophic forgetting in scientific machine learning surrogate models when faced with distribution shifts from new experimental or simulation conditions.
summary_en.method: Introduces a Single-Layer Extension (SLE) combined with Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) for task-agnostic continual learning without requiring access to prior data.
summary_en.result: SLE-FNO achieves zero forgetting and high accuracy in predicting time-averaged wall shear stress from pulsatile aneurysmal blood flow, outperforming existing CL methods in plasticity-stability balance.
summary_en.validation: Validated on 230 CFD simulations grouped into four sequential out-of-distribution tasks, comparing against eight established continual learning algorithms.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对骨植入物的应力屏蔽和骨整合问题，采用仿生梯度TPMS结构，并通过LPBF制造和力学测试验证，与用户研究方向高度吻合。
why_not_core: This paper does not include fatigue testing or surface roughness/as-built morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统骨植入物存在应力屏蔽和骨整合不足问题，需开发仿生梯度结构。
summary_zh.method: 基于Gyroid设计了四种梯度结构，采用LPBF制造，结合数值模拟和实验测试。
summary_zh.result: 梯度结构在保持低弹性模量的同时提高了渗透性，细胞实验显示良好生物相容性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学实验、CFD模拟和体外细胞实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional bone implants suffer from stress shielding and poor osseointegration, motivating the design of biomimetic gradient structures.
summary_en.method: Four gradient Gyroid-based TPMS structures were designed and fabricated via LPBF, and evaluated through numerical simulation and experimental testing.
summary_en.result: Gradient structures achieved cortical bone-level compressive strength with low elastic modulus and improved permeability, and in vitro tests confirmed cytocompatibility.
summary_en.validation: Validation included mechanical testing, CFD permeability simulation, and in vitro cell experiments.

title: Anisotropic Permeability Tensor Prediction from Porous Media Microstructure via Physics-Informed Progressive Transfer Learning with Hybrid CNN-Transformer
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息渐进迁移学习框架可迁移至生物力学代理建模，解决昂贵仿真采样效率问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on permeability prediction for porous media, not on implant biomechanics or FEA surrogate for stress/strain fields.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多孔介质渗透率张量预测中直接数值模拟耗时过长的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出结合MaxViT混合CNN-Transformer与渐进迁移学习的物理信息深度学习框架。
summary_zh.result: 在测试集上方差加权R²达0.9960，较监督基线降低33%未解释方差。
summary_zh.validation: 基于20000个合成多孔介质样本的数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Direct numerical simulation of permeability tensors from pore-scale images is computationally prohibitive, limiting large-scale uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed deep learning framework combining MaxViT hybrid CNN-Transformer with progressive transfer learning and differentiable physical constraints is proposed.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves variance-weighted R² of 0.9960 on a held-out test set, reducing unexplained variance by 33% over the supervised baseline.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a numerical benchmark of 20,000 synthetic porous media samples spanning three orders of magnitude in permeability.

title: A Hybrid Conditional Diffusion-DeepONet Framework for High-Fidelity Stress Prediction in Hyperelastic Materials
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的混合扩散-DeepONet框架可迁移至生物力学中植入物应力预测，解决高保真应力场代理建模问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not validate on biomedical implant geometries or biomechanics contexts, and lacks uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统代理模型难以同时捕捉应力集中和宽动态范围
summary_zh.method: 提出cDDPM-DeepONet混合框架，解耦应力形态与幅值预测
summary_zh.result: 在非线性超弹性数据集上精度提升1-2个数量级
summary_zh.validation: 与有限元解进行谱分析对比验证

summary_en.motivation: Traditional deep learning surrogates struggle to capture both sharp stress concentrations and wide dynamic range in hyperelastic materials.
summary_en.method: A hybrid framework decouples stress morphology via a conditional diffusion model and global amplitude via a modified DeepONet.
summary_en.result: The proposed model outperforms UNet, DeepONet, and standalone cDDPM by one to two orders of magnitude on nonlinear hyperelastic datasets.
summary_en.validation: Spectral analysis shows strong agreement with finite element solutions across all wavenumbers.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种统一的生成式多物理场学习框架，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，解决采样效率和不确定性量化问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not validate on biomedical or implant-specific FEA problems, and does not address constrained optimization or implant design tasks.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有深度学习求解器难以跨物理方程泛化，需要统一框架。
summary_zh.method: 提出pADAM，一种基于扩散模型的统一生成式框架，学习多物理场联合先验。
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE基准上实现高精度推理，支持稀疏观测和不确定性量化。
summary_zh.validation: 在标量扩散到非线性Navier-Stokes等基准上验证，并采用共形预测提供覆盖保证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing deep-learning solvers are limited to single-equation settings, lacking generalization across heterogeneous physical laws.
summary_en.method: pADAM is a unified generative framework based on diffusion models that learns a shared probabilistic prior across multiple PDE families, enabling forward and inverse inference without retraining.
summary_en.result: pADAM achieves accurate inference on diverse PDE benchmarks, even with sparse observations, and provides reliable uncertainty quantification via conformal prediction.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on numerical benchmarks including scalar diffusion and nonlinear Navier-Stokes equations, with uncertainty coverage guarantees.

title: Data-efficient Bayesian-guided design selection from large candidate sets: Application to hyperelastic stochastic metamaterials
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯引导设计选择框架可迁移至植入物力学设计中的昂贵仿真替代建模，但其应用场景为超弹性随机超材料而非生物力学。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or bone-implant interface; it focuses on hyperelastic stochastic metamaterials with no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 从大量候选设计中高效选择满足目标响应的结构，避免昂贵的高保真评估。
summary_zh.method: 通过统计特征降维和多输出高斯过程代理模型，结合不确定性驱动的主动学习进行设计筛选。
summary_zh.result: 仅需标记不到0.5%的候选集即可达到预设误差阈值。
summary_zh.validation: 在5万个候选超材料结构的数值测试中验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently identify a structure achieving a target macroscopic stress response from a large pool of admissible designs without exhaustive high-fidelity evaluations.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian-guided design selection framework that reduces dimensionality via statistical feature engineering and maps descriptors to hyperelastic parameters using a multi-output Gaussian process surrogate trained with uncertainty-driven active learning.
summary_en.result: Active learning requires labeling less than 0.5% of 50,000 candidates, and the framework reaches a prescribed error threshold with only a handful of oracle evaluations.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark on 50,000 candidate hyperelastic stochastic metamaterial structures.

title: Structure-Aware Epistemic Uncertainty Quantification for Neural Operator PDE Surrogates
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结构感知的认知不确定性量化方法，可应用于神经算子代理模型，对解决生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样效率问题具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it handle constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经算子代理模型预测存在认知不确定性，需要高效且空间保真的不确定性量化方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出结构感知的认知不确定性量化方案，仅在提升模块注入随机性，其余模块保持确定性。
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE基准上，该方法相比基线实现了更可靠的覆盖、更紧的区间和更好的残差-不确定性对齐。
summary_zh.validation: 在间断系数达西流和几何偏移3D汽车CFD代理模型上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Neural operator surrogates suffer from epistemic uncertainty due to limited data and distribution shift, necessitating efficient and spatially faithful uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A structure-aware epistemic UQ scheme is proposed that restricts Monte Carlo sampling to the lifting module of neural operators, with two lightweight perturbations: channel-wise multiplicative feature dropout and Gaussian feature perturbation.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves more reliable coverage, tighter uncertainty bands, and improved residual-uncertainty alignment on challenging PDE benchmarks compared to baselines.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks including discontinuous-coefficient Darcy flow and geometry-shifted 3D car CFD surrogates.

key_terms.zh: 计算流体动力学代理模型

visual.caption: Figure 1: Overview of neural operator architectures and our structure-aware uncertainty quantification (UQ) scheme.

title: Scalable multitask Gaussian processes for complex mechanical systems with functional covariates
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多任务高斯过程方法可处理功能协变量并量化不确定性，适用于生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真替代建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it address constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有高斯过程难以同时处理功能协变量和多任务，且需提供置信区间。
summary_zh.method: 提出可分离核结构的多任务高斯过程，利用Kronecker结构实现可扩展性。
summary_zh.result: 在铆接装配案例中，少于100个样本即可获得准确均值和置信区间预测。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成基准和铆接装配仿真案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian processes that jointly handle functional covariates and multiple correlated tasks with uncertainty quantification are underexplored.
summary_en.method: A scalable multitask Gaussian process with a fully separable kernel structure exploiting Kronecker factorization is proposed.
summary_en.result: The model achieves accurate mean and confidence interval predictions with fewer than 100 samples on a riveted assembly case.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a synthetic benchmark and a realistic riveted assembly simulation.

title: MAST: A Multi-fidelity Augmented Surrogate model via Spatial Trust-weighting
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多保真代理模型方法可直接迁移到生物力学植入物设计中，解决高保真仿真成本高的问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant design problems, nor does it include any biomechanics context or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有全局相关性假设的多保真模型在预算紧张时性能差。
summary_zh.method: 提出MAST方法，通过显式差异建模和距离加权融合高低保真数据。
summary_zh.result: 在合成基准上优于现有方法，且对预算和保真度差距鲁棒。
summary_zh.validation: 在多保真合成基准上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing multi-fidelity surrogates relying on global correlation assumptions fail under tight budget constraints due to spatially varying fidelity relationships.
summary_en.method: MAST blends corrected low-fidelity observations with high-fidelity predictions using explicit discrepancy modeling and distance-based weighting with closed-form variance propagation.
summary_en.result: MAST outperforms state-of-the-art methods on multi-fidelity synthetic benchmarks and maintains robust performance across varying budgets and fidelity gaps.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic multi-fidelity problems.

title: Generative Bayesian Computation as a Scalable Alternative to Gaussian Process Surrogates
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的生成式贝叶斯计算方法可扩展为替代高斯过程代理模型，适用于高维、非平稳问题，可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真替代建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant design problems, lacks constraint handling and uncertainty quantification in a multi-objective optimization context, and does not validate on biomechanical FEA simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 高斯过程代理模型计算成本高、假设平稳且预测分布受限，需更灵活的替代方案。
summary_zh.method: 提出生成式贝叶斯计算框架，通过隐式分位数网络学习条件分位数函数，实现高效预测。
summary_zh.result: 在14个基准测试中，GBC在CRPS指标上优于GP方法11-26%，且线性扩展至9万训练点。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准测试和主动学习任务中验证，与四种GP方法对比。

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian process surrogates suffer from cubic cost, stationarity assumptions, and Gaussian predictive distributions, motivating a more flexible and scalable alternative.
summary_en.method: Generative Bayesian Computation via Implicit Quantile Networks learns the full conditional quantile function from input-output pairs, enabling efficient predictive sampling.
summary_en.result: GBC improves CRPS by 11-26% on piecewise jump benchmarks and scales linearly to 90,000 training points, outperforming GP-based methods in 12 of 14 comparisons.
summary_en.validation: Validated on fourteen numerical benchmarks and an active learning task, comparing against four GP-based methods.

visual.caption: Figure 1: GP vs. GBC on a 1D jump function ( n = 100 n=100 , noiseless). The stationary GP (left) adapts its length scale near the discontinuity but blurs the jump; GBC (right) widens its quantile bands at the boundary. Details on the IQN architecture are in Section 3 .
visual.alt: Figure 1: GP vs. GBC on a 1D jump function ( n = 100 n=100 , noiseless). The stationary GP (left) adapts its length scale near the discontinuity but blurs the jump; GBC (right) widens its quantile bands at the boundary. Details on the IQN architecture are in Section 3 .

title: Scale-PINN: Learning Efficient Physics-Informed Neural Networks Through Sequential Correction
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的Scale-PINN方法通过顺序校正显著加速PINN训练，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，提高采样效率。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA, and lacks uncertainty quantification or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN训练慢、精度低的问题，促进工程应用。
summary_zh.method: 将数值求解器的迭代残差校正原理融入PINN损失函数，提出Scale-PINN。
summary_zh.result: 在流体动力学问题上将训练时间从数小时缩短至2分钟以内，且精度更高。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个物理领域的PDE基准问题上验证收敛速度和精度。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the slow training and limited accuracy of PINNs, hindering their adoption in science and engineering.
summary_en.method: Scale-PINN integrates the iterative residual-correction principle from numerical solvers directly into the PINN loss formulation.
summary_en.result: Achieves unprecedented convergence speed, reducing training time on a challenging fluid dynamics problem from hours to under 2 minutes while maintaining superior accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validated on PDE benchmarks from fluid dynamics, aerodynamics, and urban science, demonstrating speed and accuracy improvements.

title: Structure effects on mechanical behavior and permeability of Zn–3Mg scaffolds with gradient triply periodic minimal surface
venue: Journal of Materials Research and Technology
first_author_affiliation: School of Materials Science and Engineering, Xi'an Jiaotong University, Xi'an 710049, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Kun Sun
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Materials Science and Engineering, Xi'an Jiaotong University, Xi'an 710049, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: J X Liu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedics, The First Affiliated Hospital of Xi'an Jiaotong University, Xi'an 710061, PR China

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了Zn-Mg合金梯度TPMS多孔支架的力学行为、渗透性和生物相容性，与用户关于AM生物医学植入物的方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not include fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 缺乏对Zn-Mg合金梯度TPMS结构力学兼容性和渗透性的系统研究
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备三种梯度TPMS结构（gyroid, primitive, diamond）并进行表征
summary_zh.result: 梯度设计优化了孔隙分布，实现逐层坍塌模式，避免应力遮挡，且gyroid结构渗透性各向同性
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩测试、渗透率分析和细胞实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the lack of systematic research on mechanical compatibility and permeability of Zn-Mg alloy scaffolds with gradient TPMS structures.
summary_en.method: Zn-3Mg scaffolds with three gradient TPMS designs (gyroid, primitive, diamond) were fabricated via SLM and characterized for microstructure, mechanical behavior, and permeability.
summary_en.result: Gradient design optimized pore distribution, enabled progressive layer-by-layer collapse under compression, avoided stress shielding, and gyroid scaffolds exhibited nearly isotropic permeability.
summary_en.validation: Validation included compression testing, permeability analysis, and in vitro cell experiments.

title: Multi-material Multi-physics Topology Optimization with Physics-informed Gaussian Process Priors
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息高斯过程框架可解决多材料多物理拓扑优化中的昂贵采样问题，其方法可迁移至植入物设计中的代理建模与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it include experimental validation or patient-specific geometry.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有ML拓扑优化方法难以处理多材料多物理问题，计算成本高且存在谱偏差。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于物理信息高斯过程的框架，用神经网络参数化均值函数，联合优化目标、势能泛函和约束。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准问题上生成超分辨率拓扑，界面清晰，材料分布可解释，且训练加速。
summary_zh.validation: 通过开源代码和COMSOL商业软件验证结果。

summary_en.motivation: Existing ML-based topology optimization methods suffer from high computational cost, spectral bias, and difficulty in handling multi-material multi-physics problems with non-self-adjoint objectives.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed Gaussian process framework is proposed, where primary, adjoint, and design variables are represented by independent GP priors with neural-network-parameterized mean functions, trained by minimizing a loss combining objective, potential energy functionals, and constraints.
summary_en.result: The framework generates super-resolution topologies with sharp interfaces and interpretable material distributions, and achieves accelerated training via novel differentiation and integration schemes.
summary_en.validation: Results are validated against open-source codes and the commercial software COMSOL on benchmark problems including compliance minimization, heat conduction, and thermo-mechanical optimization.

title: Early-stage material properties as predictors of neural bioink performance during extrusion 3D bioprinting
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of Victoria, Victoria, BC, Canada

corresponding_authors.name: Victor A da Silva
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of Victoria, Victoria, BC, Canada

relevance_to_user: 该论文将机器学习集成到生物墨水的预打印配方选择中，并具有实验验证，直接推进了AI在生物打印中的应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address post-printing or closed-loop control, and focuses only on neural bioinks, not general bioprinting AI integration.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少神经生物墨水的经验试错，早期预测挤出性能。
summary_zh.method: 基于流变学特征训练机器学习模型预测生物墨水性能。
summary_zh.result: 数据驱动框架有效优先配方并减少试错。
summary_zh.validation: 通过神经元标记和神经突生长进行体外验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce empirical trial-and-error in neural bioink formulation by predicting extrusion performance from early-stage material properties.
summary_en.method: Machine learning models trained on rheological features and composition data to predict printability and biological outcomes.
summary_en.result: The data-driven framework successfully prioritized bioink formulations and demonstrated cross-material predictability.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation via in vitro culture with neuronal marker expression and neurite outgrowth.

title: GenPANIS: A Latent-Variable Generative Framework for Forward and Inverse PDE Problems in Multiphase Media
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的生成式框架可处理多相介质中的正反问题，并具备不确定性量化能力，对生物力学植入物设计中的代理建模和约束优化具有高度可迁移性。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on multiphase media (Darcy flow, Helmholtz) rather than implant biomechanics or FEA surrogate for hip implants, and does not address contact mechanics or stress shielding.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多相介质中离散材料场的不可微逆问题，避免连续近似带来的物理保真度损失。
summary_zh.method: 提出统一生成框架GenPANIS，通过连续潜嵌入实现梯度推断，结合可微粗粒度PDE求解器。
summary_zh.result: 在达西流和亥姆霍兹方程上，以更少参数超越现有方法，并支持外推和不确定性量化。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准上验证，包括未见边界条件、体积分数和微观结构形态的外推场景。

summary_en.motivation: To enable gradient-based inference for inverse problems in multiphase media with discrete material fields without resorting to continuous approximations that compromise physical fidelity.
summary_en.method: GenPANIS learns a joint latent-variable generative distribution over microstructures and PDE solutions, incorporating a differentiable coarse-grained PDE solver and a normalizing flow prior.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on Darcy flow and Helmholtz equations with 10-100 times fewer parameters, and provides principled uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks with extrapolative scenarios including unseen boundary conditions, volume fractions, and microstructural morphologies.

title: Geometry-Aware Physics-Informed PointNets for Modeling Flows Across Porous Structures
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息神经网络方法可迁移至生物力学中的植入物-骨界面流动模拟，但未涉及接触力学或应力分析。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant mechanics, stress shielding, or bone-implant interface contact; it focuses on porous media flow rather than solid mechanics or structural optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多孔结构内外耦合流动的快速预测问题
summary_zh.method: 提出物理信息PointNet和几何感知神经算子，统一损失函数约束自由流与多孔区方程
summary_zh.result: 在2D和3D案例中实现低误差预测，准确再现尾流结构
summary_zh.validation: 通过制造解验证流程，并测试对未见几何和边界条件的泛化性

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently predict coupled free and porous flows across diverse geometries without retraining.
summary_en.method: Two physics-informed learning approaches (PIPN and PI-GANO) enforce Navier-Stokes and Darcy-Forchheimer equations in a unified loss, conditioned on geometry and material parameters.
summary_en.result: Consistently low velocity and pressure errors on seen and unseen cases, with accurate wake reproduction, though performance degrades near sharp interfaces.
summary_en.validation: Method of manufactured solutions and generalization tests on 2D ducts and 3D windbreak scenarios with OpenFOAM-generated datasets.

title: Physics-Informed Laplace Neural Operator for Solving Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息拉普拉斯神经算子（PILNO）通过嵌入物理约束和虚拟输入，显著提高了小数据及分布外场景下的泛化能力，可直接迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant-related FEA problems, nor does it address multi-objective optimization or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决神经算子在小数据和分布外场景下泛化差的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出PILNO，结合改进的拉普拉斯神经算子与物理信息训练，引入虚拟输入和时间因果加权
summary_zh.result: 在四个基准PDE上，小数据时精度提升，分布外泛化优于纯数据驱动方法
summary_zh.validation: 在Burgers、Darcy流、反应扩散和KdV方程上进行数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To improve the generalization of neural operators for parametric PDEs under small-data and out-of-distribution conditions.
summary_en.method: Proposes PILNO, which integrates an enhanced Laplace Neural Operator with physics-informed training, leveraging virtual inputs and temporal-causality weighting.
summary_en.result: PILNO achieves higher accuracy in small-data regimes and stronger out-of-distribution generalization across four benchmark PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks including Burgers' equation, Darcy flow, reaction-diffusion, and forced KdV equation.

title: ArGEnT: Arbitrary Geometry-encoded Transformer for Operator Learning
relevance_to_user: 该方法将几何编码与算子学习结合，可直接迁移至基于有限元的植入物力学代理模型构建。
why_not_core: Does not specifically validate on implant biomechanics or contact mechanics, nor include experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 在变几何物理系统中高效求解算子学习问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出ArGEnT模型，将Transformer注意力机制与点云几何编码结合作为DeepONet主干。
summary_zh.result: 在流体、固体和电化学基准上精度和泛化性显著优于标准DeepONet。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个物理领域数值基准上进行精度和泛化性对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enable efficient surrogate modeling for physical systems with complex and varying geometries in many-query regimes.
summary_en.method: Proposes ArGEnT, a geometry-aware attention-based architecture using point-cloud encoding integrated as the trunk network into DeepONet.
summary_en.result: Achieves significantly improved prediction accuracy and generalization on benchmarks from fluid dynamics, solid mechanics, and electrochemistry compared to standard DeepONet.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmark problems across multiple physical domains including fluid, solid, and electrochemical systems.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接涉及LPBF制造的多孔锌支架，评估了力学性能、降解行为和生物相容性，与用户研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not explicitly link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, nor does it report fatigue testing or surface roughness/as-built morphology.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决可降解多孔支架降解速率与力学稳定性的平衡问题
summary_zh.method: 采用LPBF制造均匀和功能梯度多孔锌支架，系统研究力学、降解和细胞行为
summary_zh.result: 径向梯度支架变形能力优于纵向梯度，降解28天后保持90%力学完整性
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试、降解实验和细胞实验验证

summary_en.motivation: Balancing degradation rate with mechanical stability is a critical challenge for biodegradable porous scaffolds.
summary_en.method: Uniform and functionally graded porous Zn scaffolds with sheet-Gyroid unit cells were fabricated via L-PBF and characterized for mechanical properties, biodegradation, and biocompatibility.
summary_en.result: Radially graded scaffolds exhibited larger deformability than longitudinally graded ones, and the scaffolds maintained 90% mechanical integrity after 28 days of degradation.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing, in vitro degradation, and cell culture assays were performed.

title: Bionic gradient porous titanium rods enhance mechanics, osteogenesis, and osseointegration for load-bearing bone defect repair
first_author_affiliation: College of Medicine, Southwest Jiaotong University, kangxiao03@163.com, Chengdu, 610031, China

corresponding_authors.name: xiao kang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: College of Medicine, Southwest Jiaotong University, kangxiao03@163.com, Chengdu, 610031, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究梯度多孔钛合金棒在承重骨缺损修复中的力学性能、成骨和骨整合，与用户对AM生物医学植入物的研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not include fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or as-built morphology analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 承重骨缺损修复需要兼具力学强度和成骨能力的植入物。
summary_zh.method: 基于TPMS设计均匀孔隙和梯度孔隙钛合金棒，并进行力学测试和兔体内实验。
summary_zh.result: 梯度孔隙棒力学性能更优，更接近承重骨力学环境，且成骨和骨整合更好。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和兔体内植入实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Load-bearing bone defect repair requires implants with both mechanical strength and osteogenic potential.
summary_en.method: Two types of porous titanium alloy rods (uniform and gradient porosity) were designed using TPMS and fabricated, followed by mechanical testing and in vivo rabbit experiments.
summary_en.result: The gradient-porosity rod exhibited superior mechanical properties, better mimicking the load-bearing bone environment, and enhanced osteogenesis and osseointegration.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical testing and in vivo rabbit implantation.

title: Distribution-Free Robust Predict-Then-Optimize in Function Spaces
relevance_to_user: 该论文将保形预测扩展到无限维函数空间，为神经算子代理模型提供分布自由的鲁棒不确定性量化，可直接迁移到生物力学植入物设计的鲁棒优化中。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it include any biomedical context or experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经算子代理模型缺乏精度保证，导致优化设计在部署时性能不佳。
summary_zh.method: 将保形预测扩展到无限维Sobolev空间，为函数空间中的预测-优化提供分布自由鲁棒决策。
summary_zh.result: 在多种PDE和量子态判别任务中，鲁棒优化设计显著优于非鲁棒方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在泊松方程、热方程等PDE基准上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Neural surrogate models for PDEs lack accuracy guarantees, risking poor performance of optimized designs upon deployment.
summary_en.method: Extends conformal prediction to infinite-dimensional Sobolev spaces to provide distribution-free robust decision-making in predict-then-optimize settings.
summary_en.result: Robust optimal designs significantly outperform non-robust counterparts across diverse PDEs and a quantum state discrimination task.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on Poisson and heat equations demonstrate the generality of the functional conformal coverage method.

title: Robust design optimization for a nonlinear system via Bayesian neural network enhanced polynomial dimensional decomposition
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的BNN-PDD方法可显著降低高维非线性系统鲁棒优化的计算成本，其框架可直接迁移至植入物力学设计中的代理模型构建与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA, and lacks validation on contact mechanics or patient-specific geometries.

summary_zh.motivation: 仿真驱动的鲁棒优化计算成本高，传统代理模型难以处理强非线性问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出BNN与PDD结合的方法，通过不确定性主动学习和多点单步策略实现高效优化。
summary_zh.result: 在十维基准测试中均值降低99.97%，电机设计问题中齿槽转矩降低94.75%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数学基准和电机形状优化验证了方法的计算效率和鲁棒性。

summary_en.motivation: Simulation-based robust design optimization suffers from high computational cost for statistical moment estimation, and strong nonlinearity limits the accuracy of conventional surrogate models.
summary_en.method: This study proposes a novel RDO method integrating Bayesian neural networks with polynomial dimensional decomposition, employing uncertainty-based active learning and a multi-point single-step strategy to partition the design space.
summary_en.result: The method achieved a 99.97% mean reduction in a ten-dimensional benchmark and reduced cogging torque by 94.75% in an electric motor design problem with only 6644 finite element evaluations.
summary_en.validation: The method was validated through a mathematical benchmark and an electric motor shape optimization, demonstrating convergence to robust optimal solutions with significantly fewer function evaluations.

title: FEM-Informed Hypergraph Neural Networks for Efficient Elastoplasticity
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种将有限元计算嵌入图神经网络的方法，可高效求解弹塑性问题，其框架可直接迁移至生物力学中的植入物FEA替代建模。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on elastoplasticity and does not include implant-specific biomechanics, stress shielding, or patient-specific geometry.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统PINN在非线性固体力学中精度和效率不足，需更高效的替代模型。
summary_zh.method: 将有限元计算嵌入超图神经网络的节点和Gauss点，构建无标签数据的物理驱动学习框架。
summary_zh.result: 在3D弹塑性基准上精度和效率显著优于现有PINN变体，GPU加速下可媲美多核FEM。
summary_zh.validation: 通过循环加载和等向/随动硬化3D数值基准验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the accuracy and efficiency limitations of conventional PINNs in nonlinear solid mechanics by embedding FEM computations directly into neural network architectures.
summary_en.method: A FEM-Informed Hypergraph Neural Network (FHGNN) that integrates finite-element computations at nodes and Gauss points into message-passing layers, trained with a variational loss without labeled data.
summary_en.result: FHGNN achieves substantially improved accuracy and efficiency over recent PINN variants on 3D elastoplastic benchmarks, and can be competitive with multi-core FEM implementations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on 3D numerical benchmarks including cyclic loading with isotropic/kinematic hardening.

title: A Cycle-Consistent Graph Surrogate for Full-Cycle Left Ventricular Myocardial Biomechanics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一个基于图的代理模型用于心脏力学全周期模拟，其方法（图编码器、循环一致性、时序建模）可直接迁移到植入物生物力学代理建模中。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on cardiac mechanics rather than implant/bone biomechanics, and does not address stress shielding, micromotion, or implant-specific constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统有限元模拟心脏力学耗时，需快速代理模型
summary_zh.method: 提出基于图神经网络的代理模型，集成全局-局部图编码器、GRU时序编码器和循环一致性双向框架
summary_zh.result: 模型高保真复现FEA结果，生成生理合理的压力-容积环，且减少FEA监督数据需求
summary_zh.validation: 基于大规模FEA仿真数据集进行监督训练和验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate patient-specific left ventricular biomechanics simulation by replacing expensive finite-element analysis with a fast surrogate model.
summary_en.method: A graph-based surrogate (CGFENet) integrating a global-local graph encoder, a GRU temporal encoder conditioned on volume-time signals, and a cycle-consistent bidirectional formulation for full-cycle prediction.
summary_en.result: The surrogate achieves high fidelity to FEA ground truths, produces physiologically plausible pressure-volume loops, and reduces required FEA supervision with minimal accuracy loss.
summary_en.validation: Validated against a large dataset of FEA simulations of left ventricular mechanics.

title: Piecewise Deterministic Markov Processes for Bayesian Inference of PDE Coefficients
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合代理模型的PDMP采样器，用于贝叶斯推断PDE系数，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的不确定性量化与高效采样。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, lacks constraint handling, and only demonstrates on a 1D elasticity problem.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效贝叶斯推断非线性反问题中的PDE系数
summary_zh.method: 提出基于代理模型的PDMP采样器，结合自适应校正机制
summary_zh.result: GP代理PDMP采样器在精度和有效样本量上优于传统MCMC方法
summary_zh.validation: 在一维线弹性问题中数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To enable efficient Bayesian inference for nonlinear inverse problems with expensive likelihoods by developing a surrogate-assisted PDMP sampler.
summary_en.method: A surrogate-assisted thinning scheme is introduced, where a surrogate model provides proposal event rates and a dynamic offset correction ensures the true rate upper bound, applicable to various PDMP samplers and surrogates.
summary_en.result: PDMP samplers with GP-based surrogates achieve higher accuracy and effective sample size per forward model evaluation compared to Random Walk Metropolis and No-U-Turn Sampler.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark on a 1D linear elasticity problem for inferring a spatially varying Young's modulus.

key_terms.zh: 分段确定性马尔可夫过程

title: Imposing Boundary Conditions on Neural Operators via Learned Function Extensions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的边界条件处理方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型，解决植入物设计中复杂边界条件的建模难题。
why_not_core: No direct application to implant biomechanics or FEA surrogate for stress shielding; no experimental or clinical validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子难以处理复杂非齐次边界条件。
summary_zh.method: 通过函数扩展将边界数据映射到空间域伪扩展，使标准算子架构能消费边界信息。
summary_zh.result: 在18个含复杂边界条件的基准数据集上取得最优精度。
summary_zh.validation: 在泊松、线弹性、超弹性问题的数值基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Neural operators struggle with highly variable, non-homogeneous boundary conditions in PDE surrogates.
summary_en.method: Proposes a learned function extension that maps boundary data to latent pseudo-extensions over the entire domain, enabling any neural operator to incorporate complex BCs.
summary_en.result: Achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on 18 challenging datasets with mixed-type, component-wise, and multi-segment BCs across diverse geometries.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks for Poisson, linear elasticity, and hyperelasticity problems.

title: Generative Neural Operators through Diffusion Last Layer
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的扩散最后一层（DLL）方法可附加到任意神经算子骨干上，实现函数空间中的不确定性量化，对生物力学代理模型中的不确定性传播具有直接借鉴意义。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to any biomedical or implant design problem, nor does it address constraints or multi-objective optimization in surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经算子缺乏不确定性量化，影响实际部署的可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 提出扩散最后一层（DLL），通过低秩KL展开在函数空间建模预测不确定性。
summary_zh.result: 在随机PDE基准上提高了泛化能力和不确定性感知预测。
summary_zh.validation: 在随机PDE算子学习基准上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Neural operators lack principled uncertainty quantification, which is essential for reliable deployment in stochastic systems.
summary_en.method: We propose a diffusion last layer (DLL) that parameterizes the conditional output distribution in function space via a low-rank Karhunen-Loève expansion, attachable to any neural operator backbone.
summary_en.result: DLL improves generalization and uncertainty-aware prediction on stochastic PDE operator learning benchmarks, and enhances rollout stability in deterministic settings.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on standard stochastic PDE operator learning benchmarks, including uncertainty-aware metrics and long-horizon rollout tasks.

title: A Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Neural Operator for Mechanics of Spinodal Metamaterial
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多保真贝叶斯神经算子方法可直接迁移到植入物力学代理建模中，解决高保真数据稀缺问题。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on spinodal metamaterials rather than biomedical implants, and does not address implant-specific constraints or biomechanical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决非线性超材料力学响应数据驱动建模中高保真数据稀缺的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出贝叶斯多保真深度算子网络，结合主动学习策略选择高信息量样本
summary_zh.result: 仅用22个样本即可实现84.1%的均方误差降低，显著优于单保真基线
summary_zh.validation: 通过原位纳米力学实验与有限元模拟的多保真数据验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the scarcity of high-fidelity experimental data for data-driven modeling of nonlinear mechanical responses in cellular metamaterials.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian multi-fidelity deep operator network is proposed, integrating abundant low-fidelity FE simulations with sparse high-fidelity experimental data via a hybrid active learning strategy.
summary_en.result: Only 22 strategically selected samples from a pool of 3000 achieve an 84.1% reduction in MSE compared to the high-fidelity baseline, outperforming single-fidelity baselines.
summary_en.validation: Validated using in-situ nanomechanical experiments and finite element simulations on spinodal metamaterials.

title: Unsupervised Physics-Informed Operator Learning through Multi-Stage Curriculum Training
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无监督的物理信息算子学习方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，解决无标签数据下的高效仿真问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it handle constraints or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决无监督物理信息算子训练不稳定和泛化差的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出多阶段课程训练策略和Hermite样条傅里叶神经算子
summary_zh.result: 在标准基准上达到与监督学习相当的精度
summary_zh.validation: 在经典PDE基准上进行数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To address unstable convergence and limited generalization in unsupervised physics-informed operator learning for PDEs.
summary_en.method: A multi-stage curriculum training strategy with re-initialized optimizers and a Physics-Informed Spline Fourier Neural Operator (PhIS-FNO) using Hermite spline kernels.
summary_en.result: PhIS-FNO achieves accuracy comparable to supervised learning using only boundary label information.
summary_en.validation: Validated on canonical PDE benchmarks including Burgers' equation and Darcy flow.

title: Training-free score-based diffusion for parameter-dependent stochastic dynamical systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无需训练的扩散模型框架，用于参数依赖随机微分方程的模拟，可显著加速参数研究和不确定性量化，对生物力学代理建模具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on stochastic differential equations rather than deterministic FEA or implant biomechanics, and lacks validation on biomedical or structural mechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 参数依赖随机微分方程的高效模拟面临计算挑战，现有方法需大量训练或无法处理连续参数。
summary_zh.method: 提出无训练条件扩散模型，利用联合核加权蒙特卡洛估计条件得分函数，实现状态和参数空间的插值。
summary_zh.result: 在三个数值算例中准确逼近不同参数下的条件分布，无需重新训练即可生成新参数轨迹。
summary_zh.validation: 通过三个复杂度递增的数值算例验证方法准确性。

summary_en.motivation: Simulating parameter-dependent SDEs is computationally expensive as separate simulations are needed for each parameter value, and existing ML methods either require costly training or lack continuous parameter handling.
summary_en.method: A training-free conditional diffusion model is proposed, using a joint kernel-weighted Monte Carlo estimator to approximate the conditional score function, enabling interpolation across state and parameter spaces.
summary_en.result: The method accurately approximates conditional distributions for varying parameter values across three numerical examples without retraining.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on three numerical benchmarks of increasing complexity.

key_terms.zh: 参数依赖随机微分方程

title: Probabilistic function-on-function nonlinear autoregressive model for emulation and reliability analysis of dynamical systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的概率性函数型非线性自回归模型可显著提升动态系统仿真的效率，并支持不确定性量化，有望迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant mechanics problems, nor does it address constraints or multi-objective optimization typical in implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 构建高效准确的动态系统代理模型以解决高维非线性映射难题
summary_zh.method: 提出函数型函数非线性自回归模型，结合主成分分析与高斯过程回归实现概率预测
summary_zh.result: 新方法在效率上比现有NARX模型提升数个数量级，精度更高，并支持主动学习
summary_zh.validation: 通过不同复杂度的动态系统案例验证模型性能

summary_en.motivation: To construct accurate and computationally efficient surrogate models for predicting dynamical system responses under strongly nonlinear and high-dimensional mappings.
summary_en.method: A function-on-function nonlinear autoregressive model with exogenous inputs (F2NARX) is proposed, combining principal component analysis and Gaussian process regression for probabilistic predictions via unscented transform.
summary_en.result: F2NARX outperforms state-of-the-art NARX models by orders of magnitude in efficiency while achieving higher accuracy, and enables active learning for first-passage failure probability estimation.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on dynamical system case studies of varying complexity, demonstrating superior efficiency and accuracy.

key_terms.zh: 非线性自回归外生输入模型

title: Maximizing Reliability with Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯优化方法针对极小失效概率的昂贵黑箱优化问题，可迁移至植入物设计中的可靠性优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics, and lacks validation on FEA-based surrogate models.

summary_zh.motivation: 针对制造中极小失效概率的昂贵黑箱优化问题，提出高效贝叶斯优化方法。
summary_zh.method: 基于汤普森采样和知识梯度，结合重要性采样处理极低失效概率。
summary_zh.result: 所提方法在极端和非极端场景下均优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently optimize the reliability of designs subject to random perturbations, where failures are extremely rare, using Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.method: Two Bayesian optimization methods based on Thompson sampling and knowledge gradient are proposed, incorporating importance sampling to target failure probabilities as low as 10^-8.
summary_en.result: The proposed methods outperform existing approaches in both extreme and non-extreme failure probability regimes.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmark problems with known failure probabilities.

title: Geometric Generalization of Neural Operators from Kernel Integral Perspective
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多尺度神经算子方法可推广到不同几何形状，有望用于生物力学植入物设计的代理建模。
why_not_core: No application to implant or biomechanics design; no uncertainty quantification; no experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决神经算子在非参数化几何上的泛化难题
summary_zh.method: 基于核积分视角，提出受Ewald求和启发的多尺度神经算子
summary_zh.result: 在多种核函数和三维流体动力学算例上展示了鲁棒的几何泛化能力
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试和三维流体动力学算例验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of generalizing neural operators to variable and nonparametric geometries in engineering design.
summary_en.method: A multiscale neural operator inspired by Ewald summation is proposed by recasting operator learning as approximation of geometry-dependent kernel integrals.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates robust geometric generalization across diverse kernels and a large-scale 3D fluid dynamics example.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard kernels and a 3D fluid dynamics simulation case.

title: Nonlinear continuous gradient-regulated porous architectures fabricated by selective laser melting for enhanced biomechanical compatibility
first_author_affiliation: School of Mechanical Engineering, Dalian Jiaotong University, Dalian, 116028, China

corresponding_authors.name: Xiaowei Ma
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedics, Affiliated Zhongshan Hospital of Dalian University, Dalian 116001, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对LPBF制造的多孔结构，通过梯度设计匹配骨刚度以减少应力遮挡，并进行了力学测试，与用户研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not include fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有假体难以个性化匹配患者骨力学特性，导致应力遮挡和骨吸收。
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制造三种连续非线性梯度TPMS多孔结构（Diamond, Gyroid, IWP），调控弹性模量。
summary_zh.result: 梯度设计使平行梯度方向模量降低，同时保持垂直方向强度和延展性，模量在人体骨生理范围内。
summary_zh.validation: 通过准静态压缩实验验证力学性能，并与均匀多孔模型对比。

summary_en.motivation: Current prostheses fail to achieve personalized mechanical matching with patient bone tissue, leading to stress shielding and bone resorption.
summary_en.method: Three types of continuously nonlinear gradient TPMS porous structures (Diamond, Gyroid, IWP) were fabricated via SLM to tailor the elastic modulus.
summary_en.result: The gradient design reduces modulus parallel to the gradient direction while maintaining compressive strength and ductility perpendicular to it, with modulus within the physiological range of human bone.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through quasi-static compression tests and compared with uniform porosity models.

title: Multi-Fidelity Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Bayesian Uncertainty Quantification and Adaptive Residual Learning for Efficient Solution of Parametric Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对昂贵仿真采样效率问题，结合多保真度、贝叶斯不确定性量化和自适应残差学习，方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design problems, nor does it demonstrate validation on biomedical FEA cases.

summary_zh.motivation: 高保真参数化PDE求解计算成本高，需高效多保真方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出MF-BPINN框架，结合贝叶斯UQ与自适应残差网络学习保真度间非线性映射。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准问题上显著提升预测精度与计算效率。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Solving high-fidelity parametric PDEs is computationally prohibitive, motivating the development of efficient multi-fidelity frameworks.
summary_en.method: We propose MF-BPINN, a multi-fidelity framework integrating Bayesian uncertainty quantification and adaptive residual learning with learnable gating to capture nonlinear correlations across fidelity levels.
summary_en.result: The method achieves superior accuracy and computational efficiency on several benchmark parametric PDE problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks including diffusion-reaction and Burgers' equations.

title: Mechanical properties and biocompatibility of Ta/Ti6Al4V composite porous structures printed using selective laser melting
first_author_affiliation: College of Mechanical Engineering, Zhejiang University of Technology 1 , Hangzhou 310023,

corresponding_authors.name: Gaolin Yang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: College of Mechanical Engineering, Zhejiang University of Technology 1 , Hangzhou 310023,

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了多孔结构匹配骨刚度、SLM制造及力学测试，与用户方向高度相关。
why_not_core: Does not report fatigue testing, surface roughness, or as-built morphology.

summary_zh.motivation: 结合钽和钛合金优势，制备匹配骨刚度的多孔植入物。
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备Ta/Ti6Al4V复合多孔结构，实现冶金结合。
summary_zh.result: 弹性模量1.9-2.9 GPa匹配人骨，压缩强度66-87 MPa，生物相容性良好。

title: Bayesian Interpolating Neural Network (B-INN): a scalable and reliable Bayesian model for large-scale physical systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种可扩展的贝叶斯代理模型，适用于大规模物理系统的不确定性量化，可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真替代。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant mechanics problems, nor does it address constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_en.method: The Bayesian Interpolating Neural Network combines high-order interpolation theory with tensor decomposition and alternating direction algorithm to achieve linear complexity Bayesian inference.

summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks validate the computational efficiency and uncertainty calibration of the proposed method.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的可扩展元学习多目标贝叶斯优化方法，能够利用历史数据加速昂贵优化问题求解，可迁移至植入物设计中的多目标优化与代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not include any FEA or biomechanics context, nor does it validate on implant design or structural mechanics problems.

summary_zh.method: 提出基于多输出高斯过程的可扩展元学习模型SMOG，构建结构化联合先验。
summary_zh.result: 在基准测试和应用中展现出强数据效率，性能稳定。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准多目标基准和实际应用上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Multi-objective optimization with expensive evaluations can be accelerated by leveraging historical data from related tasks via meta-learning.
summary_en.method: SMOG uses a multi-output Gaussian process to build a structured joint prior across meta- and target tasks, enabling closed-form prior conditioning and linear scaling.
summary_en.result: The method achieves competitive data efficiency across benchmarks and applications, outperforming standard multi-objective Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic benchmarks and real-world applications, demonstrating strong performance without experimental or clinical validation.

title: FIRE: Multi-fidelity Regression with Distribution-conditioned In-context Learning using Tabular Foundation Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多保真度回归方法可直接迁移到植入物设计中的昂贵仿真替代建模，解决数据不平衡和不确定性量化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design; it lacks domain-specific validation in biomedical FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多保真度回归中高保真数据稀疏和GP模型扩展性差的问题。

summary_en.method: FIRE uses tabular foundation models for zero-shot in-context Bayesian inference, conditioning a high-fidelity correction model on low-fidelity posterior distributions.
summary_en.result: FIRE outperforms seven state-of-the-art methods on 31 benchmarks, achieving top accuracy and uncertainty quantification with runtime advantages.
summary_en.validation: Validated on 31 synthetic and real-world benchmarks including DrivAerNet and LCBench.

title: Physics-Informed Uncertainty Enables Reliable AI-driven Design
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种物理信息不确定性方法，可显著提高代理模型优化效率，适用于生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真替代。
why_not_core: Paper focuses on frequency-selective surfaces and electromagnetic design, not on implant biomechanics or structural FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统代理模型优化缺乏不确定性量化，导致数据稀疏区域预测错误。
summary_zh.method: 提出物理信息不确定性，以物理定律违反程度作为预测不确定性代理，集成到多保真优化流程。
summary_zh.result: 设计成功率从<10%提升至>50%，计算成本降低一个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 在20-30 GHz频率选择表面设计任务中验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional surrogate-assisted optimization lacks uncertainty quantification, leading to poor performance in data-sparse regions.
summary_en.method: Introduces physics-informed uncertainty, using the degree of violation of physical laws as a cheap proxy for predictive uncertainty, integrated into a multi-fidelity optimization workflow.
summary_en.result: Increases design success rate from less than 10% to over 50% while reducing computational cost by an order of magnitude.
summary_en.validation: Validated on the design of frequency-selective surfaces in the 20-30 GHz range.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Illustration of how a single-fidelity surrogate-assisted optimization workflow may lead to erroneous designs as the design deviates from its’ training distribution whereas an uncertainty-aware multi-fidelity workflow efficiently utilizes high-fidelity evaluations in balancing ‘exploration’ and ‘exploitation’ for robust design optimization. The novel aspect of this work is the validation of physics-based rules as an effective uncertainty metric in this real-world problem of metasurface design.

title: SFO: Learning PDE Operators via Spectral Filtering
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的神经算子方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，减少昂贵仿真采样成本。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant FEA problems; no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification demonstrated.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经算子难以高效捕捉PDE解映射中的长程非局部相互作用。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于希尔伯特矩阵特征模态的通用谱基，参数化积分核并学习快速衰减的谱系数。
summary_zh.result: 在六个基准上以更少参数实现最高精度，误差降低高达40%。
summary_zh.validation: 在反应扩散、流体动力学和3D电磁学基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Neural operators struggle to efficiently capture long-range nonlocal interactions in PDE solution maps.
summary_en.method: The Spectral Filtering Operator parameterizes integral kernels using a fixed global orthonormal basis derived from Hilbert matrix eigenmodes, learning only rapidly decaying spectral coefficients.
summary_en.result: SFO achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on six benchmarks, reducing error by up to 40% with substantially fewer parameters.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks including reaction-diffusion, fluid dynamics, and 3D electromagnetics.

title: Autoregressive deep learning for real-time simulation of soft tissue dynamics during virtual neurosurgery

why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, stress shielding, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it focuses on brain tissue deformation for surgical simulation.

summary_en.method: An autoregressive deep learning surrogate model based on Universal Physics Transformers, trained with a stochastic teacher forcing strategy to reduce error accumulation during long rollouts.
summary_en.result: The surrogate model achieves sub-10 ms inference per step on meshes up to 150,000 nodes, reducing maximum prediction error from 6.7 mm to 3.5 mm.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a large dataset generated from nonlinear finite element simulations covering diverse instrument-tissue interaction scenarios.

title: Constraint-Aware Neurosymbolic Uncertainty Quantification with Bayesian Deep Learning for Scientific Discovery

summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture assays and mechanical testing (insertion force, expulsion force, rotational stability) were used.

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenges of fabricating functional pigmented skin models with high reliability and efficient nutrient delivery.
summary_en.method: A hybrid bioprinting strategy combining extrusion and microvalve deposition was developed, with a particle swarm optimization-tuned fractional-order proportional-integral controller for precise motion control.
summary_en.result: The engineered skin model exhibited uniform pigment distribution and excellent biological performance, while reducing culture medium consumption to 10% of conventional requirements.
summary_en.validation: Histological characterization and functional assays confirmed uniform pigment distribution and biological performance of the printed skin model.

summary_en.motivation: To develop a personalized shape memory NiTi implant that can be delivered minimally invasively for cavitary bone defect reconstruction.
summary_en.method: A 4D-printed NiTi mesh implant was fabricated via selective laser melting, enabling time-dependent shape transformation from a compressed state to its original shape.
summary_en.result: The implant required 156 N for 30% deformation and achieved complete shape recovery; clinical follow-up at 12 months showed excellent osseointegration and functional recovery with a Musculoskeletal Tumor Society score of 29.
summary_en.validation: Validation included micro-CT geometric fidelity analysis, SEM-EDS microstructure characterization, phase transformation testing, compression testing, and clinical imaging at 6 and 12 months.

summary_en.motivation: To design bone scaffolds that reduce stress shielding and promote osseointegration by creating a uniform mechanical environment.
summary_en.method: Patient-specific TPMS scaffolds were designed to match trabecular bone morphometry and apparent elastic modulus, and evaluated via finite element simulations.
summary_en.result: Patient-specific scaffolds achieved 83.86% similarity in stress distribution to target bone, significantly outperforming non-specific designs.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through finite element simulation only, without experimental fabrication or testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现单细胞在可组合刚度梯度微凝胶中的封装，以研究细胞在微尺度界面的响应。
summary_zh.method: 集成增强深度学习模型与时间离散生物打印，通过数字微镜器件生成动态掩模控制打印。
summary_zh.result: 成功封装MDA-MB-231细胞，刚度梯度超过2 kPa时细胞向软区域延伸。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外细胞实验验证了微凝胶刚度梯度对细胞行为的影响。

summary_en.motivation: To encapsulate single cells in microgels with composable stiffness gradients for investigating cellular responses at microscale interfaces.
summary_en.method: An enhanced deep learning model for single-cell localization was integrated with time-discrete bioprinting using a digital micromirror device to generate dynamic masks for real-time control.
summary_en.result: MDA-MB-231 cells were encapsulated in GelMA microgels with tunable stiffness (1.42–11.42 kPa), and cells extended toward softer regions when stiffness gradient exceeded 2 kPa.
summary_en.validation: In vitro experiments with MDA-MB-231 cells validated the effect of stiffness gradients on cell behavior.
